title: Conventional AM, envelope and modulation index

visualBrief.description: Compare conventional AM envelopes for mu=0.5 and mu=1.5; show zero crossings and label envelope distortion rather than implying all demodulators fail.
visualBrief.alt: Conventional AM, envelope and modulation index; Conventional AM includes carrier plus sidebands. For ordinary envelope recovery, keep mu at or below one.

from.label: MathWorks: analog passband modulation; reference for the modulation families

walkthrough.say: For a single tone, conventional AM is s(t)=Ac[1+mu*cos(2*pi*fm*t)]cos(2*pi*fc*t).
Use an envelope comparison to distinguish conventional AM from our suppressed-carrier lab waveform.
Conventional AM includes carrier plus sidebands. For ordinary envelope recovery, keep mu at or below one.
